name: Tabnav Accessibility Widget
author: Tabnav

sections.description:
Tabnav Accessibility Widget is an AI-powered solution that enhances your website’s accessibility, helps meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards, and creates a better browsing experience for people with disabilities. Designed for simplicity, performance, and full customization, it takes just one click to activate.

Whether you’re a developer, agency, or business owner, Tabnav helps you stay compliant and user-friendly—without slowing down your site.

🎯 Key Features (Free Plan)

  • ✅ Screen Reader: Reads content aloud for visually impaired users.
  • ✅ Keyboard Navigation: Navigate without a mouse.
  • ✅ Voice Navigation: Control the site with voice commands.
  • ✅ Text Reader: Convert text to speech instantly.
  • ✅ Contrast Options: Switch between light/dark contrast modes.
  • ✅ Saturation & Monochrome: Adjust for visual comfort.
  • ✅ Content Adjustments: Text size, line spacing, letter spacing, etc.
  • ✅ Text Alignment: Align text left, right, or center.
  • ✅ Highlight Links and Titles: Emphasize important content.
  • ✅ Readable Fonts: Enable clear, accessible typography.
  • ✅ Bigger Cursor: Improve pointer visibility.
  • ✅ Stop Animations: Pause moving content for focus.
  • ✅ Language Switcher: 44+ languages built-in.
  • ✅ Customize widget position (left/right) and size (normal/small).
  • ✅ One-click install, no setup required.
  • ✅ Built-in Accessibility Statement.
  • ✅ Issue Report Form (email-based).
  • ✅ 24/7 support included.

🚀 Pro Features (Paid Plan)

  • 🔒 Accessibility Profiles:
    • Motor Impaired
    • Dyslexia
    • ADHD
    • Cognitive
    • Visual Impairments
    • Seizures
  • 🔒 Monthly accessibility scans
  • 🔒 Assistive technologies support
  • 🔒 Team collaboration tools
  • 🔒 Custom feedback form integration

All paid plans include everything in Free + premium features.

This makes Tabnav a safe and compliant solution for businesses and organizations operating within the European Union, including under the EAA (European Accessibility Act) and local data protection laws.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/tabnav-accessibility-widget/ or install directly from the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to Settings → Accessibility Widget to customize.
  4. Choose your language, position, widget size, and toggle visibility.
  5. The accessibility button appears instantly on your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

No. The plugin works out of the box without any API key or signup.

Will it slow down my website?

Not at all. Tabnav widget loads asynchronously and is optimized for speed and performance.

Is it WCAG-compliant?

Yes. The widget supports WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines and helps you meet major global accessibility requirements.

Can I customize it?

Yes. You can customize:
– Widget size (normal/small)
– Widget button size
– Color and branding
– Position (left/right)
– Language (from 44+ available)

Can I disable it on specific pages?

Not yet—but this feature is planned for future updates.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. Tabnav is theme-agnostic and stays fixed on top using a high z-index.

What data is collected?

The widget collects only non-identifiable data necessary for accessibility functions. No personal data is stored or shared without user consent.
